policy: Hand-authored crosswalk from the twelve FRS regions to the Ofgem charge-restriction regions whose cap levels price the imputed energy columns (microcosm#890 F). Each FRS region maps to the charge-restriction region covering most of its households (dominant area); Northern Ireland lies outside the GB cap and takes the GB average level. The Ofgem ids are the vendored ofgem_price_cap_facts.json geography ids.

source.citation: Ofgem energy price cap: charge-restriction regions (fourteen GB distribution areas) against ONS regions; dominant-area mapping reviewed for microcosm#890.

notes: North Wales and Merseyside (ofgem:n_wales_and_mersey) and Northern Scotland (ofgem:northern_scotland) are not a dominant area for any FRS region and are unused.
Standing charges differ materially between areas (2024-Q3 electricity GBP 234 in Yorkshire against GBP 142 in London), which is why pricing is regional rather than the GB average.

provenance.basis: Ofgem publishes the price cap by charge-restriction region, the fourteen electricity distribution (DNO) areas; each FRS (ONS) region is mapped to the distribution area that serves most of its population. The mapping is asserted from the published area definitions, not from a published population crosswalk, and stands as a ruling (reviewer question on PR #927).

rationale.NORTH_WEST: Electricity North West (ofgem:north_west); Merseyside lies in ofgem:n_wales_and_mersey but Greater Manchester, Lancashire and Cumbria dominate.
rationale.SOUTH_EAST: UK Power Networks South Eastern area, Kent, Surrey and Sussex (ofgem:south_east); the Hampshire, Berkshire and Oxfordshire part of the region is SSEN Southern (ofgem:southern), the smaller share.
rationale.WALES: National Grid South Wales area (ofgem:south_wales); North Wales lies in ofgem:n_wales_and_mersey, the smaller share of Welsh households.
rationale.SCOTLAND: SP Distribution central-belt area (ofgem:southern_scotland); the Highlands and islands lie in SSEN North (ofgem:northern_scotland), the smaller share.
rationale.NORTHERN_IRELAND: Outside the GB cap (Utility Regulator NI); priced at the GB average level (K03000001).
